newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Aug palmoil output seen up 11 pct - Ivan.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Aug palmoil output seen up 11 pct - Ivan.

text.p: Malaysia's palmoil output in August rose by an estimated 11 percent to 801,000 tonnes over July, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Friday.
Wong estimated end-Aug palmoil stocks at 775,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 754,634 tonnes at end-July.
He said palm oil exports in August was projected to be 680,000 tonnes from PORLA's 646,017 tonnes.

"Production in Peninsular rose around five percent. The performance of major producers/millers ranged from down three percent to up 15 percent," Wong said, adding that in east Malaysia production increases ranged widely from five-35 percent.
Wong has revised downward the end-August stock to 775,000 tonnes because of an upward revision in offtake.
The excellent export performance was attributed to higher offtake by major importers like India, China, the European Union and West Asia, he said.
Wong viewed the latest price adjustments as healthy for the longer-term demand outlook.
Malaysia crude palmoil supply-demand estimate/projection as of September 13, 1996. (All figures in '000 tonnes)
